title: Stow Bedon V.5851 Memorial
crew_summary: 3 killed including Sgt. Frank Brown Graham Heron

maintainer.organisation: Stow Bedon and Breckles Parish Council

external_narratives.summary: Imperial War Museums register entry for the memorial to the crew of Blenheim V5851 at Stow Bedon, Norfolk. Records the crash of the 21 Squadron aircraft three miles south of its base at RAF Watton.
external_narratives.key_details: Crew: Sgt F.G.B. Heron (pilot, RCAF, age 20), F/Sgt G.D. Maluish (observer, RCAF, age 23), Sgt G.E. Step (air gunner, RAF, age 20). An eyewitness reported the pilot deliberately put the nose down to avoid hitting a nearby house.

external_narratives.summary: Norfolk County Council heritage record for the Bristol Blenheim crash site at Stow Bedon. Catalogued as a heritage monument with location details and basic incident information.
external_narratives.key_details: Crash site formally recorded in the Norfolk Historic Environment Record. Aircraft crashed three miles south of RAF Watton.

local_contacts.org_name: Stow Bedon and Breckles Parish Council
local_contacts.role: Local authority responsible for memorial upkeep

memorial_details:
Name: Bristol Blenheim V5851
Type: Stone of remembrance
Description: Grey (probably slate), rectangular tablet mounted at a shallow angle on a low brick plinth. The memorial is surrounded by grey granite chippings contained within low rectangular kerbstones. The dedication is incised in white upper-case letters. The outline of a Bristol Blenheim is incised in the top-left corner with the 21 Squadron badge in the top-right.
Inscription: IN MEMORY OF/SGT. F.G.B. HERON PILOT RCAF AGED 20/ FLT. SGT. G.D. MALUISH AIR OBSERVER RCAF AGED 23/ SGT. G.E. STEP AIR GUNNER RAF AGED 20/ THESE MEN, ALL OF 21 SQUADRON, RAF WATTON/ WERE KILLED WHEN THEIR BRISTOL BLENHEIM, V5851/ CRASHED NEAR THIS SPOT ON 7TH JUly 1942/ "AN EYEWITNESS REPORTED THAT THE BLENHEIM/ WAS FLYING STRAIGHT FOR THIS HOUSE AND THAT THE PILOT PUT THE NOSE DOWN CRASHING INTO THE FIELD./ BUT FOR THE COURAGE OF THESE MEN EVERYONE IN THE HOUSE WOULD HAVE PERISHED./ (poem by Stephen Spender)
Location: 60 metres west of junction with Mere Road Cherry Tree Lane Stow Bedon Breckland Norfolk NR17 1BY England
Grid Ref: TL 95593 95934
Coordinates: 52.526154803540,0.881847510850
